summary: Hengaw reported that Iranian Intelligence Ministry agents arrested Kurdish men Hamidreza Shahmohammadi, at his kiosk in Imam Hossein Square, and shopkeeper Seyed Hamzeh Hashemi, at his store, where tear gas was used, in Awdenan on the afternoon of 21 November without a warrant, and took them to an undisclosed location. Hengaw put the number detained over the protests against the deaths of 13 workers in a bus crash at at least 14; ANF, citing Kolber News, reported 12 named detainees.

sources.title: Hengaw: Hamidreza Shahmohammadi and Seyed Hamzeh Hashemi arrested in Abdanan, detention toll reaches 14
ANF: Awdanan'da gözaltına alınanların sayısı 12'ye yükseldi

summary: Hengaw reported that Iranian Intelligence Ministry agents in several vehicles arrested Bahman Rahimzadeh, a 27-year-old Kurdish man, at the auto repair shop where he worked in Mehabad on 21 November without a warrant. His whereabouts, the reason for his arrest and any charges are not known.

sources.title: Hengaw: Intelligence forces raid workplace, arrest Bahman Rahimzadeh in Mahabad

summary: Hengaw reported that Iranian security forces arrested four young Kurds, Mohammad Mirzaei, Mohammadamin Amraei, Arian Imani and Amir Garavand, in Dereşar on the evening of 20 November without a warrant, amid a wave of arrests across Ilam province. Their whereabouts, the reasons for their arrest and any charges are not known.

sources.title: Hengaw: Four young Kurds arrested in Ilam Province, whereabouts unknown

summary: Hengaw and Kurdpa reported on 20–21 November that Iranian Intelligence Ministry agents arrested Hassan Faraji, a 38-year-old Kurdish man from Îlam, without a warrant at a holiday residence in the Cheshmeh Pahn area on 11 November; he has since been held incommunicado, without a lawyer or family contact, and his whereabouts and any charges are not known.

sources.title: Hengaw: Kurdish man Hassan Faraji held incommunicado for 11 days following arrest in Ilam
Kurdpa: Ilam; 10 days of arbitrary detention and unknown fate of Hassan Faraji

summary: Hengaw reported on 20 November that Iranian authorities executed Esmail Ahmadzadeh (Esmail Korde), a Kurdish prisoner from Sine (Sanandaj) living in Hashtgerd, in Karaj Central Prison on 17 November without telling his family or allowing a last visit; he had been sentenced to death for 'premeditated murder' over a street fight about four years ago in which he had been stabbed twice. State media did not announce the execution.

sources.title: Hengaw: Esmail Ahmadzadeh secretly executed in Karaj Central Prison

summary: Mezopotamya Agency, citing SOHR, reported on 21 November that Turkish soldiers shot dead a young man from Naim al-Jalad village, Til Hemîs, near Dêrik as he tried to cross into Turkey to find work; SOHR counts 15 civilians killed and 61 injured by Turkish soldiers' fire in 2026. The exact date and spot of the shooting and the man's name were not given.

sources.title: Mezopotamya Ajansı: SOHR: Türk askerlerinin ateşi sonucu bir genç yaşamını yitirdi
